meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: Claude 会调用 lark-cli 抓取你指定日期的日程和未完成任务，整理成摘要：日程表、待办列表，以及小结（会议/待办数、冲突提醒、空闲时段）。时间戳会转为北京时间，会议状态会标注。
howto.when: 当你想了解今天、明天或本周的日程与待办安排时触发。

say.text: 今天有哪些会议和待办？
say.note: 生成今天的日程与待办摘要

say.text: 明天有什么日程？还有哪些没完成的任务？
say.note: 生成明天摘要，含冲突提醒

say.text: 列出本周所有会议和未完成任务
say.note: 生成本周摘要，按时间排序

howto.what_en: Claude calls lark-cli to fetch events and incomplete tasks for a specified date, then produces a summary with an event table, to-do list, and a brief overview (counts, conflicts, free slots). Timestamps are converted to local time and RSVP status is shown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about your schedule and tasks for today, tomorrow, or this week.

say_en.text: What meetings and todos do I have today?
What's on my schedule tomorrow and what tasks are unfinished?
List all meetings and unfinished tasks this week
say_en.note: Generates weekly summary sorted by time
